title: The Rule of 72 in 10 seconds
caption:
Divide 72 by your yearly return to see how many years your money takes to double.
At 8%: 72 ÷ 8 = 9 years.
At 12%: 6 years.
comment: What return are you getting right now? 👇
sources: Rule of 72: years to double ≈ 72 ÷ annual return (%). 1.08^9 = 1.999
